title: Fix Safari login: missing Secure + SameSite=None on auth cookie
description: Safari 17 drops the auth cookie on the redirect from mail.acme-co.com → app.acme-co.com because the cookie does not set Secure or SameSite=None. Reproduces 100% in private mode. Three customers blocked (Northwind, Beacon, multiple SMBs). Fix is two lines in src/auth/redirect.ts. Same PR must add a WebKit-target Playwright test — the Feb 2026 postmortem already had this action item and it was deprioritized.
next_step: Open PR with two-line cookie attribute fix in src/auth/redirect.ts AND a WebKit-target Playwright test that exercises the cross-subdomain redirect. Do not merge without the test.

title: Implement CSV export v2: tuple cursor + NDJSON + column selection
description: Replace src/api/export/csv.ts with a streaming export that uses a (created_at, id) tuple cursor (not single-column created_at — would skip rows on bursty timestamps), supports format=csv|ndjson on the same endpoint, and accepts a whitelisted columns query param. Land behind csv_export_v2 feature flag this week; external launch waits on the rate-limit refactor. Northwind QBR is May 30 — internal demo by then is the bar; first half of June for external.
next_step: Land streaming implementation behind csv_export_v2 feature flag this week. Use src/api/orders/list.ts as the pattern for tuple-cursor pagination. Keep external launch blocked on rate-limit work; demo to Northwind first half of June.

title: Refactor rate-limit middleware to Redis-backed sliding window
description: src/middleware/rateLimit.ts uses an in-process Map with a windowed counter that resets on every deploy (we deploy 2-3x/day). This already trips during local CSV v2 testing and is the critical blocker for CSV v2 external launch. RFC approved (Redis sliding window with INCR + EXPIRE + small Lua script for atomicity); same Redis instance we already run. Stale PR #42 is being closed and replaced with a fresh PR.
next_step: Close PR #42. Open a fresh PR Monday 2026-05-11 implementing the Redis sliding window per the approved RFC. Lin to confirm Redis memory headroom by Friday before the new keyspace lands.
